Alex / Priya — thanks for the note and the copy of the executed SOW. Congrats — really looking forward to getting Rivermark to production. I attached a first draft of an embedded MAP (RIV-MAP-v1.pdf) and a companion canary checklist (canary-checklist.xlsx). High-level sequencer below — targeted to meet your Aug 31 board milestone while leaving room for a conservative canary: 

Embedded MAP (draft summary)
- Prep (Week 0–1): provisioning, model pinning, network/VPC checks, test data ingest.
  - Deliverables: env manifest, admin access list, data access test file.
- Canary (Week 2): 2-day internal canary + 5-day pilot with subset of real traffic (10–15%)
  - Success criteria: latency P95 < 300ms on representative traffic, error rate < 1%, model output recall within ±3% of baseline eval set, no data egress anomalies.
  - Rollback triggers: token-rate anomalies, sustained error spikes >1% over 30m, severe regression on eval prompts.
- Migration (Week 3): traffic ramp to 50% guided by automatic prefix caching & rolling model variant fallback, full production cutover at end of week if canary holds.
- Training & Handover (Week 3–4): two 90-minute sessions (ops + data team) + runbook handoff and acceptance sign-off.

Proposed near-term schedule (if you approve):
- Week of Jul 27: Prep + environment handoff
- Week of Aug 3: Internal canary (dry run)
- Week of Aug 10: Pilot canary with limited traffic
- Week of Aug 17: Migration window (ramp)
- Week of Aug 24: Training + final cutover (target go-live)

Open items we need from Rivermark this week:
1) Admin user list and their email addresses (for SSO + admin console access)
2) Short sample of representative traffic (5–10k tokens) or a synthetic test harness
3) Confirmation of preferred training dates the week of Aug 24

Ownership & contacts
- Day-to-day at Redwood: me (Aditya Rao, Account Exec) — aditya@redwood.com, +1 (415) 555-0124
- CS lead (ops, runbook & training): Marissa Cole — marissa_cole@redwood.com
- Technical lead for canary/routing: Laura Bennett — laura_bennett@redwood.com

I’ve flagged the items in the attached MAP and added a short playbook for rollback options. If that schedule looks reasonable I’ll convert the MAP to a shared Drive doc and propose concrete time slots for training.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
